findings.passage: We must ensure that every eligible voter, including our newly naturalized citizens, is not unfairly disenfranchised
findings.note: Quoted in her House caucus news release announcing a letter to the Secretary of State about cancelled registrations of people flagged as noncitizens who had since naturalized.
